name: Gravitas
source:
In the distant galaxy of Treppan64-b, a lonely space station rotates slowly on its decaying orbital anchor. This space station, a humble observatory, sits at the edge of known space. Manned by your wolf crewmate Herman and yourself, you were to finish one standard 4 cycle deployment before being relieved.

Unfortunately, all that you knew and loved was devoured by a supermassive black hole named Fenrir. Now you and Herman are alone, at the end of the universe. Feeling the inevitability of The End with each call of Fenrir's gravitational howls, one must ask: what would you do if you and a handsome wolf were the last beings left in existence? 

[From [url=https://embersfennec.itch.io/gravitas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的Treppan64-b星系中，一个孤独的空间站在其腐烂的轨道锚上缓慢旋转。这个空间站是一个简陋的天文台，坐落在已知空间的边缘。在你的狼队友赫尔曼和你自己的带领下，你将完成一次标准的4循环部署，然后才能松一口气。

不幸的是，你所知道和所爱的一切都被一个名为芬里尔的超大质量黑洞吞噬了。现在你和赫尔曼孤身一人，在宇宙的尽头。随着芬里尔的每一次引力嚎叫，人们都感受到了终结的必然性，人们必须问：如果你和一只英俊的狼是最后剩下的生物，你会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://embersfennec.itch.io/gravitas]Itch.io[/url]]
